23.hindi_meaning: चूना पत्थर (कैल्शियम कार्बोनेट से बनी एक प्रकार की चट्टान)
23.example: Limestone can undergo heat and pressure to transform into marble.

23.english_meaning: A metamorphic rock formed from limestone, widely used in sculpture and architecture.
23.hindi_meaning: संगमरमर (चूना पत्थर के रूपांतरण से बनने वाली चट्टान)
23.example: The Taj Mahal is built entirely of white marble.

23.english_meaning: Naturally occurring inorganic solid substances with a definite chemical composition.
23.hindi_meaning: खनिज (प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले ठोस पदार्थ जिनका एक निश्चित रासायनिक संगठन होता है)
23.example: Different minerals are used to make utensils, ornaments, and tools.

23.english_meaning: Things used to make something look more attractive, or items of jewelry worn for adornment.
23.hindi_meaning: आभूषण / गहने (सौंदर्य या सजावट के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली वस्तुएं)
23.example: Gold and silver are precious minerals often crafted into ornaments.

23.english_meaning: A tool with a heavy metal head used for breaking things or driving in nails.
23.hindi_meaning: हथौड़ा (चीजें ठोकने या तोड़ने के लिए लोहे के सिर वाला औजार)
23.example: The geologist used a small hammer to break the rock sample.

23.english_meaning: A deep, circular Indian cooking pot similar to a wok.
23.hindi_meaning: कड़ाही (भोजन पकाने का एक पारंपरिक बर्तन)
23.example: A karhai is typically made of iron or aluminium and used for frying.

23.english_meaning: A large flat or concave disk-shaped frying pan used in South Asian cuisine.
23.hindi_meaning: तवा (रोटी या पराठा सेकने का बर्तन)
23.example: The iron tava was kept on the stove to heat up.

23.english_meaning: The middle point or part of something.
23.hindi_meaning: केंद्र (किसी वस्तु या स्थान का ठीक बीच का हिस्सा)
23.example: It is impossible for humans to go to the centre of the earth due to extreme heat.

23.english_meaning: Particulate matter that can be transported by fluid flow and which eventually is deposited.
23.hindi_meaning: अवसाद (मिट्टी, रेत और कण जो पानी या हवा द्वारा बहाकर लाए जाते हैं)
23.example: Rivers carry loose sediments and deposit them in layers.
Iron and copper are minerals commonly used in household items.

23.english_meaning: To establish or recognize who or what something is.
23.hindi_meaning: पहचानना (किसी वस्तु या बात की शिनाख्त करना)
23.example: Students were asked to identify the minerals used in making bells.

23.english_meaning: Material things that can be seen and touched.
23.hindi_meaning: वस्तुएं / चीजें (जिन्हें देखा और छुआ जा सके)
23.example: We use various objects made of different metals every day.

23.english_meaning: Made different; transformed into another form or substance.
23.hindi_meaning: परिवर्तित होना / बदलना (एक रूप से दूसरे रूप में बदलना)
23.example: Under extreme heat and pressure, limestone is changed into marble.

23.english_meaning: Relating to the earth's physical structure, substance, and history.
23.hindi_meaning: भूगर्भीय (पृथ्वी की संरचना और इतिहास से संबंधित)
23.example: Understanding rock types is an important part of geological studies.

24.english_meaning: A small, compressed ball or rounded mass of a substance.
24.example: Take a small coloured paper pellet and put it in a beaker.

24.english_meaning: Liquefied by heat, especially metals or rock.
24.example: The molten magma inside the earth moves in a circular manner.

24.english_meaning: Hot fluid or semifluid material below or within the earth's crust.
24.hindi_meaning: मैग्मा (पृथ्वी के भीतर का पिघला हुआ चट्टानी पदार्थ)
24.example: The molten magma inside the earth moves very slowly.

24.english_meaning: The rigid outer part of the earth, consisting of the crust and upper mantle.
24.example: The lithosphere is broken into a number of plates known as the Lithospheric plates.

24.english_meaning: Massive, irregularly shaped slabs of solid rock that make up the Earth's lithosphere.
24.example: These lithospheric plates move around very slowly each year.

24.english_meaning: Forces that act in the interior of the earth.
24.hindi_meaning: अंतर्जात बल (पृथ्वी के आंतरिक भाग में कार्य करने वाले बल)
24.example: The forces which act in the interior of the earth are called Endogenic forces.

24.english_meaning: Forces that work on the surface of the earth.
24.hindi_meaning: बहिर्जात बल (पृथ्वी की सतह पर कार्य करने वाले बल)
24.example: The forces that work on the surface of the earth are called Exogenic forces.

24.english_meaning: The outermost layer of a planet.
24.example: The earth’s crust consists of several large and small plates.

24.english_meaning: Stiff and inflexible; not bending or being forced out of shape.
24.example: The earth's crust consists of rigid, irregularly-shaped plates.

24.english_meaning: Any of the world's main continuous expanses of land.
24.example: These rigid plates carry continents and the ocean floor.

24.english_meaning: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.
24.example: Figure 3.1 shows the evolution of landforms.

24.english_meaning: Relating to the deformation of the earth's crust involving mountain building.
24.hindi_meaning: पटल विरूपणी (पर्वत निर्माण करने वाले धीमे बल)
24.example: Diastrophic forces build mountains over long periods.

24.english_meaning: Relating to the gradual destruction or diminution of something by wind, water, or other natural agents.
24.example: Erosional and depositional forces shape the surface of the earth.

24.english_meaning: Relating to the laying down of sediment carried by wind, water, or ice.
24.example: Rivers and winds act as erosional and depositional agents.

24.english_meaning: The action or process of causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists.
24.example: Sudden movements like earthquakes and volcanoes cause mass destruction.

25.english_meaning: A vent or opening in the earth's crust through which molten material erupts suddenly.
25.hindi_meaning: ज्वालामुखी - पृथ्वी कीपपड़ी में एक छिद्र जिससे पिघला हुआ पदार्थ अचानक निकलता है।
25.example: A volcano is a vent in the earth's crust through which molten material erupts.

25.english_meaning: A pool of molten rock located beneath the surface of the earth.
25.hindi_meaning: मैग्मा कोष्ठ - पृथ्वी की सतह के नीचे पिघली हुई चट्टानों का भंडार।
25.example: Magma collects in a chamber beneath the volcano before an eruption.

25.english_meaning: A bowl-shaped area at the top of a volcano around the central vent.
25.hindi_meaning: क्रेटर / ज्वालामुखी का मुख - ज्वालामुखी के ऊपर का कटोरे के आकार का मुहाना।
25.example: Ash and gases are released from the crater of the volcano.

25.english_meaning: An opening allowing escape of gas, steam, or magma from underground.
25.hindi_meaning: छिद्र / निकास द्वार - पृथ्वी के भीतर से गैस या मैग्मा निकलने का मार्ग।
25.example: A volcano is a vent in the earth's crust.

25.english_meaning: The outermost solid layer of the earth.
25.hindi_meaning: पपड़ी / भूपर्पटी - पृथ्वी की सबसे बाहरी ठोस परत।
25.example: The place in the crust where the movement starts is called the focus.

25.english_meaning: The layer of the earth between the crust and the core.
25.hindi_meaning: मैंटल / प्रवार - भूपर्पटी और क्रोड के बीच की पृथ्वी की परत।
25.example: Magma originates from the mantle layer of the earth.

25.english_meaning: Molten rock flowing from a volcano onto the earth's surface.
25.hindi_meaning: लावा - पिघली हुई चट्टान जो ज्वालामुखी से सतह पर बहती है।
25.example: Hot lava flowed down the slopes of the mountain.

25.english_meaning: Sudden shaking or vibration of the earth's surface caused by the movement of lithospheric plates.
25.hindi_meaning: भूकंप - पृथ्वी की सतह का अचानक हिलना या कांपना।
25.example: The earth vibrates when an earthquake occurs.

25.english_meaning: The point inside the earth's crust where an earthquake starts and seismic energy originates.
25.hindi_meaning: उद्गम केंद्र (फोकस) - वह स्थान जहाँ पृथ्वी के भीतर से भूकंप की शुरुआत होती है।
25.example: The focus is the origin of the seismic energy during an earthquake.

25.english_meaning: The place on the earth's surface directly above the focus.
25.hindi_meaning: अधिकेंद्र (एपिसेंटर) - फोकस के ठीक ऊपर पृथ्वी की सतह पर स्थित बिंदु।
25.example: Greatest damage is usually closest to the epicentre.

25.english_meaning: Waves of energy produced by an earthquake that travel through the earth.
25.hindi_meaning: भूकंपीय तरंगें - भूकंप के दौरान उत्पन्न ऊर्जा की तरंगें जो चारों तरफ फैलती हैं।
25.example: Seismic waves radiate out in all directions from the focus.

25.english_meaning: The broken pieces of the earth's crust that float on the mantle.
25.hindi_meaning: स्थलमंडलीय प्लेटें - पृथ्वी की पपड़ी के बड़े खंड जो तैरते हैं।
25.example: When the lithospheric plates move, the surface of the earth vibrates.

25.english_meaning: Formed or occurring from forces within the earth.
25.hindi_meaning: अंतर्जनित - पृथ्वी के आंतरिक बलों से संबंधित।
25.example: Endogenic forces cause sudden movements like earthquakes and volcanoes.

25.english_meaning: Formed or occurring from forces on the earth's surface.
25.hindi_meaning: बहिर्जनित - पृथ्वी की सतह पर काम करने वाले बलों से संबंधित।
25.example: Exogenic forces shape the landforms from outside.

25.english_meaning: To move continuously and rapidly back and forth.
25.hindi_meaning: कंपन करना / हिलना - तेजी से आगे-पीछे हिलना।
25.example: The earth vibrates when an earthquake occurs.

26.english_meaning: The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
26.hindi_meaning: पर्यावरण या परिवेश जिसमें जीव-जंतु और पौधे निवास करते हैं।
26.example: We must protect our environment from pollution and natural disasters.

26.english_meaning: An instrument that measures and records details of earthquakes, such as force and duration.
26.hindi_meaning: भूकंपमापी यंत्र, जिससे भूकंप की तीव्रता और अवधि मापी जाती है।
26.example: An earthquake is measured with a machine called a seismograph.

26.english_meaning: The great size or extent of something; in geology, the measure of the energy released by an earthquake.
26.hindi_meaning: भूकंप की तीव्रता या परिमाण (विनाशक क्षमता का माप)।
26.example: The magnitude of the earthquake is measured on the Richter scale.

26.english_meaning: A numerical scale for expressing the magnitude of an earthquake on the basis of seismograph oscillations.
26.hindi_meaning: रिएक्टर पैमाना (भूकंप की तीव्रता मापने का यंत्र)।
26.example: A massive earthquake measuring 6.9 on Richter scale hit Bhuj Town.

26.english_meaning: Arranged in classes or categories according to shared qualities or characteristics.
26.example: A 7.0 magnitude earthquake is classified as a major earthquake.

26.english_meaning: A place giving temporary protection from bad weather or danger.
26.example: Know where to take shelter during an earthquake, such as under a sturdy desk.

26.english_meaning: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
26.example: Spread awareness amongst your friends and family members regarding disaster safety.

26.english_meaning: A sudden accident or a natural catastrophe that causes great damage and loss of life.
26.example: The Chief Minister of Gujarat appealed to the Centre to deal with the disaster.

26.english_meaning: Reduced to the smallest possible amount or degree.
26.example: The impact of earthquakes can certainly be minimised if we are prepared beforehand.

26.english_meaning: Feeling or appearing troubled, nervous, or restless.
26.example: Fish in the ponds get agitated before a major earthquake.

26.english_meaning: Large and heavy or solid; exceptionally large in scale.
26.example: A massive earthquake hit Bhuj Town on 26th January 2001.

26.english_meaning: A serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
26.example: The President declares a state of emergency in the quake zone.

26.english_meaning: (Of a structure) suddenly fall down or give way.
26.hindi_meaning: धड़ाम से गिरना या ढह जाना।
26.example: Many students lost their lives following the collapse of school buildings.

26.english_meaning: The action or process of transmitting something or the broadcasting of something.
26.hindi_meaning: संचरण (बिजली या संदेश पहुँचाने की व्यवस्था)।
26.example: Power station transmission lines were knocked out during the quake.
The relief effort in the earthquake-hit region remained blighted for days.

27.english_meaning: The breaking up of rocks on the earth's surface due to natural processes.
27.hindi_meaning: अपक्षय (पृथ्वी की सतह पर चट्टानों का टूटना)
27.example: Weathering is the first step in altering the earth's landscape.

27.english_meaning: The wearing away of the landscape by different agents like water, wind, and ice.
27.hindi_meaning: अ अपरदन (जल, पवन और हिम द्वारा भूमि का कटाव)
27.example: Soil erosion reduces the fertility of agricultural land.

27.english_meaning: The laying down or dropping of eroded material by water, wind, or ice.
27.example: The deposition of silt forms fertile river plains.

27.english_meaning: Natural features of the earth's surface, such as mountains, valleys, and plains.
27.example: Different landforms are created by the processes of erosion and deposition.

27.english_meaning: A place where flowing water tumbles steeply down a rocky valley side.
27.example: Angel Falls is the highest waterfall in the world.

27.english_meaning: Large twists and turns or bends formed by a river as it enters a plain.
27.example: The river forms large meanders as it flows across the flat plain.

27.english_meaning: A cut-off lake formed when a meander loop gets separated from the main river.
27.example: The abandoned meander loop eventually turned into an ox-bow lake.

27.english_meaning: Fine soil and other material deposited by a river along its banks during floods.
27.example: Floodwaters leave behind rich sediments that enrich the soil.

27.english_meaning: A flat and fertile area formed by layers of soil deposited along river banks during floods.
27.example: The annual flooding of the river creates a wide and fertile floodplain.

27.english_meaning: Raised banks formed along a river due to deposition during floods.
27.example: The raised banks along the river are known as levees.

27.english_meaning: All the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.
27.example: The natural landscape is continuously shaped by wind and water.

27.english_meaning: Carried from one place to another.
27.hindi_meaning: परिवहनित / एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर ले जाया गया
27.example: Eroded materials are transported downstream by the running water.

27.english_meaning: In the end, after a long time, or after a series of events.
27.example: The transported rock particles are eventually deposited in lower areas.

27.english_meaning: Forming an unbroken whole; without interruption.
27.example: Continuous erosion changes the shape of the river valley over time.

27.english_meaning: Coming near or closer to something in distance or time.
27.example: As the river approaches the sea, its speed decreases significantly.

28.english_meaning: Branches of a river that flow away from the main stream and do not return to it, typically found near the mouth in a delta.
28.hindi_meaning: वितरिकाएँ (मुख्य नदी से अलग होने वाली छोटी धाराएँ)
28.example: Near the sea, the main river breaks up into several distributaries.

28.english_meaning: To lay down or drop sediment, rock, or soil in a specific location through natural processes like water or wind.
28.example: The slow-moving river begins to deposit its load of sand and silt.

28.english_meaning: Matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid, or small pieces of rock and soil carried and deposited by water, ice, or wind.
28.example: The collection of sediments from all the mouths forms a delta.

28.english_meaning: A wetland that forms as river waters empty into a slower-moving body of water, depositing sediments in a triangular shape.
28.example: The Sundarbans is a famous delta formed by the Ganges and Brahmaputra rivers.

28.english_meaning: The process of eroding or being eroded by wind, water, or other natural agents.
28.example: Coastal erosion is caused by the continuous striking of sea waves against rocks.

28.english_meaning: The geological process in which sediments, soil, and rocks are added to a landform or land mass.
28.example: The deposition of sand along the shores creates beautiful beaches.

28.english_meaning: Of, relating to, or near a coast.
28.example: Lighthouses are common landmarks along the coastal areas.

28.english_meaning: An empty space, hole, or hollow area inside something.
28.example: As sea waves strike the rocks, cavities are formed over time.

28.english_meaning: Natural rock formations where sea caves have been eroded all the way through, creating an arched opening.
28.example: When the cavity of a sea cave breaks through completely, it forms a sea arch.

28.english_meaning: Geological landforms consisting of a steep and often vertical column or columns of rock in the sea near a coast.
28.example: After the roof of a sea arch collapses, only the vertical walls called stacks are left.

28.english_meaning: A steep rock face created by the destructive action of waves on a coast.
28.hindi_meaning: समुद्री भृगु / समुद्र तट की खड़ी चट्टान
28.example: The steep rocky coast rising vertically above the sea water is known as a sea cliff.

28.english_meaning: Large masses of ice formed from compacted snow that move slowly down a slope or valley.
28.example: Glaciers are often described as rivers of ice that erode the landscape.

28.english_meaning: Moving or clearing earth and stones forcefully, similar to the action of a bulldozer.
28.hindi_meaning: बुलडोज़ करने की तरह ज़ोर लगाकर हटाना / कुचलना
28.example: Glaciers erode the landscape by bulldozing soil and stones.

28.english_meaning: Fine sand, clay, or other material carried by running water and deposited as a sediment.
28.example: The river water was muddy and full of silt.

28.english_meaning: Masses of rocks, dirt, and other materials deposited by a melting glacier.
28.example: The rocks and sand deposited by the melting glacier form glacial moraines.

29.english_meaning: The wearing away of the earth's surface by natural forces like wind, water, or ice.
29.example: Wind and water are powerful agents of erosion in desert landscapes.

29.english_meaning: The laying down of sand, soil, or rocks that have been moved by wind, water, or ice.
29.hindi_meaning: निक्षेपण (मलवे या रेत का जमा होना)
29.example: The deposition of sand by the wind creates low hill-like structures called dunes.

29.english_meaning: Rocks shaped like a mushroom, with a narrow base and a wider top, formed by wind erosion.
29.hindi_meaning: छत्रक चट्टान (मशरूम के आकार की चट्टानें)
29.example: You can easily spot various mushroom rocks in arid desert regions.

29.english_meaning: Low hill-like structures of sand formed by the deposition of wind-blown sand.
29.hindi_meaning: बालू के टिब्बे (मरुस्थल में रेत के टीले)
29.example: Camels walked gracefully across the rolling sand dunes of the Thar Desert.

29.english_meaning: Fine and light grains of sand deposited over large areas by the wind.
29.hindi_meaning: लोएस (हवा द्वारा उड़कर लाई गई उपजाऊ मिट्टी के विशाल निक्षेप)
29.example: Large and extensive deposits of loess are found in northern China.

29.english_meaning: Relating to forces that originate on or above the surface of the earth.
29.hindi_meaning: बहिर्जात बल (पृथ्वी की सतह पर काम करने वाले बल)
29.example: Weathering and erosion are examples of exogenic forces shaping the earth.

29.english_meaning: Relating to forces that originate from within the earth.
29.hindi_meaning: अंतर्जात बल (पृथ्वी के भीतर उत्पन्न होने वाले बल)
29.example: Earthquakes and volcanoes are caused by sudden endogenic forces.

29.english_meaning: Flat areas of land bordering a river, formed by the deposition of river sediment during floods.
29.hindi_meaning: बाढ़ मैदान (नदी द्वारा बाढ़ के समय लाई गई मिट्टी के निक्षेप से बने मैदान)
29.example: Farmers grow rich crops on the fertile flood plains near the river.

29.english_meaning: U-shaped lakes that form when a wide meander of a river is cut off from the main stream.
29.example: The meandering river eventually formed an ox bow lake as it changed its course.

29.english_meaning: Glacial debris consisting of rocks, sand, and soil deposited by a melting glacier.
29.hindi_meaning: हिमान्ढ़ ओढ़ (हिमनद द्वारा लाई गई मिट्टी और पत्थरों का निक्षेप)
29.example: The glacier left behind a large ridge of moraine at its retreating edge.

29.english_meaning: Carries or moves people or things from one place to another.
29.hindi_meaning: एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर ले जाना (परिवहन करना)
29.example: Strong winds effortlessly transports sand grains across vast distances.

29.english_meaning: Put or left down in a specific place, typically by a natural process.
29.example: The silt carried by the river was deposited along the banks.

29.english_meaning: A slowly moving mass or river of ice formed by the accumulation and compaction of snow.
29.example: The movement of a glacier carves out deep valleys in the mountains.

29.english_meaning: A mountain or hill having a vent through which lava, rock fragments, hot vapor, and gas are ejected.
29.example: An active volcano can cause sudden and drastic changes to the earth's surface.

29.english_meaning: Ready or likely to attack or confront; forceful.
29.example: Note: Used implicitly for powerful natural forces like active agents of erosion.

30.english_meaning: A large mass of ice moving slowly down a mountain valley or over land.
30.example: The glacier slowly carves the valley as it moves downward.

30.english_meaning: A series of regular curves or loops in the course of a river.
30.hindi_meaning: नदी के बड़े मोड़ या विसर्प
30.example: The river forms large meanders across the flat plains.

30.english_meaning: A pebbly or sandy shore, especially by the ocean between high and low water marks.
30.example: We collected seashells along the sandy beach.

30.english_meaning: A ridge or mound of sand created by the wind, found in deserts or near beaches.
30.example: Strong winds shift the sand dunes in the desert.

30.english_meaning: An outpouring of water falling from a height, typically over a cliff.
30.example: The mountain stream drops sharply to form a beautiful waterfall.

30.english_meaning: A sudden and violent shaking of the ground, sometimes causing great destruction.
30.example: The powerful earthquake caused massive damage to the buildings.

30.english_meaning: A rock shaped like a mushroom, formed by wind erosion of its base.
30.example: Desert winds erode the lower section of rocks to create mushroom rocks.

30.english_meaning: An area of low-lying ground adjacent to a river, formed mainly of river sediments and subject to flooding.
30.example: Farmers grow crops on the flood plains because the soil is extremely fertile.

30.english_meaning: (Of land or soil) producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops.
30.example: The delta region has rich and fertile soil for agriculture.

30.english_meaning: A type of cave formed primarily by the wave action of the sea.
30.example: Constant crashing of waves forms sea caves along the rocky coast.

30.english_meaning: A geological landform consisting of a steep and often vertical column or columns of rock in the sea near a coast.
30.example: Over time, the roof of the sea cave collapses, leaving behind rocky stacks.

30.english_meaning: To fall down or cave in suddenly.
30.example: Weak structures tend to collapse during heavy tremors.

30.english_meaning: Relating to or caused by the gradual destruction or removal of rock or soil by natural forces.
30.example: A waterfall is primarily an erosional landform.

30.english_meaning: Relating to the geological process in which sediments, soil, and rocks are added to a landform.
30.example: Sand dunes are formed by depositional processes of wind.

30.english_meaning: A natural feature of the earth's surface.
30.example: Rivers create various landforms as they flow from mountains to the sea.

31.english: At an angle of 90° to a given line, plane, or surface; vertical and straight up and down.
31.example: The cliff formed a steep perpendicular face along the sea coast.

31.english: Scattered pieces of rubbish, remains, or rocky material carried by natural forces like glaciers.
31.hindi_meaning: मलबा या टूटे हुए पत्थरों के अवशेष
31.example: The glacier carried a large amount of debris, including boulders and coarse material.

31.english: Having the shape of a curved sickle or a growing moon, tapering at both ends.
31.example: A crescent-shaped lake was formed by the meandering river.

31.english: Following a winding, twisting course rather than a straight line.
31.example: The meandering river created large loops and bends across the plain.

31.english: Far away from other places, buildings, or objects; separated or solitary.
31.example: An isolated mass of rising steep rock stood near the coastline.

31.english: Made up of sand, earth, and other matter left by water, especially rivers.
31.hindi_meaning: जलोढ़ (नदी द्वारा लाई गई मिट्टी से बना)
31.example: Fertile alluvial tracts of land are formed at the mouth of the river.

31.english: A wall or bank of earth or stone built to prevent a river from flooding its banks.
31.example: The embankment on the river keeps it securely in its channel.

31.english: An empty space, hole, or hollow area inside something.
31.example: Waves crashing against weak rocks formed a natural cavity.

31.english: A slowly moving mass or river of ice formed by the accumulation and compaction of snow.
31.example: A glacier is a moving mass of ice found in high mountain regions.

31.english: An act of moving downward, dropping, or falling from a higher to a lower place.
31.hindi_meaning: ढलान, नीचे की ओर बहाव या गिरावट
31.example: The sudden descent of water in the river bed creates a waterfall.

31.english: Laid down or left behind a layer of sediment or material by natural agents like wind or water.
31.example: Fine sand was deposited by the action of the wind to form dunes.

31.english: A mound or ridge of sand formed by the wind, usually in deserts or along coasts.
31.example: Strong winds created a small hill of sand known as a sand dune.

31.english: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.
31.example: The friction of wind on the water surface causes the rise and fall of waves.

31.english: The outline or boundary of a coast, where the land meets the sea or ocean.
31.example: Lighthouses are often built along the rocky coastline.

31.english: The bed where a natural stream of water runs or the deeper part of a river or harbor.
31.example: The continuous flow of water carved a deeper channel in the valley.

32.english_meaning: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
32.example: All living beings on this earth depend on the atmosphere for their survival.

32.english_meaning: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist.
32.example: Plants need nitrogen and water for their survival.

32.english_meaning: The nature of something's ingredients or constituents; the way in which a whole is made up.
32.example: We are studying the composition of the atmosphere in geography class.

32.english_meaning: The components or parts that make up a whole.

Nitrogen is the most plentiful gas in the air.

32.english_meaning: Breathe in air or other gases.
32.example: When we inhale, we take oxygen into our lungs.

32.english_meaning: Breathe out air or other gases from the lungs.
32.example: We inhale fresh air and exhale carbon dioxide.

32.english_meaning: The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere due to the greater transparency of the atmosphere to visible radiation from the sun than to infrared radiation emitted from the planet's surface.
32.example: Carbon dioxide creates a greenhouse effect by trapping the heat radiated from the earth.

32.english_meaning: Emitted or transmitted as rays or waves.
32.example: The greenhouse gases trap the heat radiated from the earth's surface.

32.english_meaning: An amount of gas or smoke that smells strongly or is dangerous to inhale.
32.example: Car fumes and factory smoke increase the level of carbon dioxide in the air.

32.english_meaning: Kept; not lost or allowed to pass away.
32.example: The heat retained by greenhouse gases increases the temperature of the earth.

32.english_meaning: A gradual increase in the overall temperature of the earth's atmosphere generally attributed to the greenhouse effect.

32.english_meaning: Likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; radical and extreme.
32.example: There may be drastic changes in the climate due to pollution.

32.english_meaning: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being no longer in existence.
32.example: Climate change can lead to the extinction of some plants and animals.

32.english_meaning: Of, relating to, or near a coast.
32.example: Rising sea levels can cause severe floods in coastal areas.

33.english_meaning: A colorless, odorless unreactive gas that makes up about 78% of the earth's atmosphere.
33.hindi_meaning: नाइट्रोजन (हवा में पाई जाने वाली एक मुख्य गैस)
33.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil for their growth.

33.english_meaning: The process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water.
33.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश संश्लेषण (वह प्रक्रिया जिससे हरे पौधे अपना भोजन बनाते हैं)
33.example: Green plants produce oxygen during photosynthesis.

33.english_meaning: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
33.hindi_meaning: वायुमंडल (पृथ्वी को घेरने वाली हवा की परत)
33.example: Factories add billions of tons of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.

33.english_meaning: A colorless, odorless gas produced by burning carbon and organic compounds and by respiration.
33.hindi_meaning: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड (सांस छोड़ने और जलाने पर निकलने वाली गैस)
33.example: Green plants use carbon dioxide to make their food.

33.english_meaning: The movement of air or liquid through a system or area.
33.hindi_meaning: संचरण या घुमाव (हवा या पानी का बहना)
33.example: That is how air circulation takes place in the atmosphere.

33.english_meaning: Becomes larger or wider, or makes something larger or wider.
33.hindi_meaning: फैलना या आकार में बड़ा होना
33.example: When air is heated, it expands and becomes lighter.

33.english_meaning: Closely compacted in substance; having high density.
33.hindi_meaning: घना या भारी (कम स्थान में अधिक मात्रा)
33.example: Cold air is denser and heavy compared to hot air.

33.english_meaning: All around a particular place or thing.
33.example: Cold air from the surrounding area rushes to fill in the gap.

33.english_meaning: Interrupted, upset, or altered from a normal state or balance.
33.example: If we cut trees, this natural balance gets disturbed.

33.english_meaning: The weather conditions prevailing in an area in general or over a long period.
33.example: Increased volume of carbon dioxide is affecting the earth's weather and climate.

33.english_meaning: A gradual increase in the overall temperature of the earth's atmosphere.
33.hindi_meaning: ग्लोबल वार्मिंग (पृथ्वी के तापमान में लगातार वृद्धि)
33.example: Is global warming a serious issue in today's world?

33.english_meaning: Occurring continuously over a period of time; staying the same.
33.example: The oxygen content in the air remains constant through photosynthesis.

33.english_meaning: The amount of space that something takes up, or the amount of something.
33.example: The increased volume of carbon dioxide is harming the environment.

33.english_meaning: Microscopic living organisms, some of which can fix nitrogen in the soil.
33.example: Bacteria live in the soil and roots of some plants.

33.english_meaning: Think about something carefully, especially before making a decision or reaching a conclusion.
33.example: Read and ponder: Is global warming a serious issue?

34.english_meaning: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
34.example: The earth's atmosphere is divided into five distinct layers.

34.english_meaning: The lowest layer of the atmosphere, where all weather phenomena occur.
34.example: Almost all weather phenomena like rainfall and fog occur in the troposphere.

34.english_meaning: The layer of the atmosphere above the troposphere, ideal for flying aeroplanes.
34.example: The stratosphere is almost free from clouds, making it ideal for flying aeroplanes.

34.english_meaning: The third layer of the atmosphere, lying above the stratosphere, where meteorites burn up.
34.example: Meteorites burn up in the mesosphere upon entering from space.

34.english_meaning: The layer of the atmosphere above the mesosphere where temperatures rise rapidly with height.
34.example: In the thermosphere, temperature rises very rapidly with increasing height.

34.english_meaning: The outermost layer of the earth's atmosphere.
34.example: The exosphere is the uppermost layer of our atmosphere before entering outer space.

34.english_meaning: A fact or situation that is observed to happen, especially one whose cause is in question.
34.example: Weather phenomena like rainfall and fog occur in the troposphere.

34.english_meaning: A storm with heavy falls of hail.
34.example: The hailstorm damaged the crops in the field.

34.english_meaning: Pieces of rock or metal from space that enter the earth's atmosphere.
34.example: Meteorites burn up in the mesosphere on entering from space.

34.english_meaning: A layer of the atmosphere that contains ions and is part of the thermosphere.
34.example: The ionosphere helps in transmitting radio waves back to the earth.

34.english_meaning: To cover a specified area or distance; to stretch out.
34.example: The stratosphere extends up to a height of 50 km.

34.english_meaning: A colorless gas that absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
34.example: The ozone layer protects us from the harmful ultraviolet rays of the sun.

34.english_meaning: A number expressing the typical or middle value in a set of data.
34.example: The average height of the troposphere is 13 km.

34.english_meaning: Very quickly; at a great rate.
34.example: The temperature in the thermosphere rises very rapidly with increasing height.

34.english_meaning: The outside part or uppermost layer of something.
34.example: Our atmosphere is divided into five layers starting from the earth’s surface.

35.english_meaning: The uppermost layer of the earth's atmosphere where the air is very thin and light gases float into space.
35.hindi_meaning: बहिर्मंडल - वायुमंडल की सबसे ऊपरी परत जहाँ वायु बहुत पतली होती है।
35.example: Light gases like helium and hydrogen float into space from the exosphere.

35.english_meaning: The hour-to-hour or day-to-day condition of the atmosphere at a place.
35.hindi_meaning: मौसम - वायुमंडल की घंटे-दर-घंटे या दिन-प्रतिदिन की स्थिति।
35.example: Weather can change dramatically from day to day.

35.english_meaning: The average weather condition of a place over a longer period of time.
35.hindi_meaning: जलवायु - किसी स्थान की लंबी समयावधि की औसत मौसम की स्थिति।
35.example: The desert region has a very hot and dry climate.

35.english_meaning: Experiencing worry, unease, or nervousness, typically about an imminent event or something with an uncertain outcome.
35.hindi_meaning: चिंतित या उत्सुक - किसी अनिश्चित परिणाम को लेकर बेचैन होना।
35.example: The anxious cricket fans were speculating about the fate of the match.

35.english_meaning: Forming a theory or conjecture about a subject without firm evidence.
35.example: Fans were speculating whether the match would be interrupted by rain.

35.english_meaning: Containing or characterized by a large amount of water vapour in the air.
35.hindi_meaning: नम या उमस भरा - हवा में नमी की अधिकता होना।
35.example: A hot and humid weather may make one irritable.

35.english_meaning: Having or showing a tendency to be easily annoyed or made angry.
35.hindi_meaning: चिड़चिड़ा - जो आसानी से गुस्सा हो जाए।
35.example: Hot and humid weather can make people irritable.

35.english_meaning: In a sudden and striking way.
35.hindi_meaning: नाटकीय रूप से या अचानक और बहुत अधिक रूप से।
35.example: Weather can change dramatically from day to day.

35.english_meaning: The incoming solar energy intercepted by the earth.
35.hindi_meaning: आतपन - पृथ्वी द्वारा प्राप्त होने वाली सूर्य की ऊर्जा।
35.example: An important factor that influences the distribution of temperature is insolation.

35.english_meaning: Stopped, blocked, or caught in transit before reaching a destination.
35.hindi_meaning: रोक लिया गया या बीच में ही ग्रहण किया गया।
35.example: Insolation is the solar energy intercepted by the earth.

35.english_meaning: The way in which something is shared out among a group or spread over an area.
35.hindi_meaning: वितरण - किसी चीज़ का फैलाव या बँटवारा।
35.example: The distribution of temperature varies from the equator to the poles.

35.english_meaning: An imaginary line drawn around the earth equally distant from both poles, dividing the earth into northern and southern hemispheres.
35.example: The amount of insolation decreases from the equator towards the poles.

35.english_meaning: An instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.
35.example: A thermometer is used to measure the temperature of the atmosphere.

35.english_meaning: An instrument measuring atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather.
35.hindi_meaning: बैरोमीटर - वायुमंडलीय दाब मापने वाला यंत्र।
35.example: The barometer helps in measuring atmospheric pressure.

35.english_meaning: The action or process of broadcasting something, or transmitting radio waves.
35.hindi_meaning: प्रसारण - रेडियो तरंगों या संकेतों को भेजना।
35.example: The layer helps in radio transmission by reflecting waves back to the earth.

36.english_meaning: A heavy, rough building material made from a mixture of broken stone or gravel, sand, cement, and water.
36.hindi_meaning: कंक्रीट (सिमेंट, बजरी और पानी का मिश्रण)
36.example: The concrete and metals in buildings get heated up during the day.

36.english_meaning: A dark, tar-like material used for paving roads.
36.hindi_meaning: डामर या पक्की सड़क बनाने की सामग्री
36.example: The asphalt of roads gets heated up during the day.

36.english_meaning: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
36.example: As we go up the layers of atmosphere, the pressure falls rapidly.

36.example: Air pressure is highest at sea level and decreases with height.

36.english_meaning: To apply or bring to bear a force, influence, or quality.

36.english_meaning: A pressure acting in the opposite direction to another pressure.
36.hindi_meaning: प्रति-दाब (विपरीत दिशा में लगने वाला दबाव)
36.example: Our body exerts a counter pressure to balance the weight of air.

36.english_meaning: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.
36.example: Horizontally, the distribution of air pressure is influenced by temperature.

36.english_meaning: The way in which something is shared out among a group or spread over an area.
36.example: The horizontal distribution of air pressure varies across different regions.

36.english_meaning: Having an effect on the character, development, or behavior of someone or something.

36.english_meaning: Go down sideways or drop lower, especially slowly.

36.english_meaning: People who are trained to travel in a spacecraft.
36.example: Astronauts have to wear special protective space suits on the moon.

36.english_meaning: A duct or canal, such as an artery or vein, through which blood passes in the body.
36.example: Without space suits, the blood vessels of the astronauts would burst.

36.example: The wind blowing from the west is called westerly.

37.english_meaning: The speed of something in a given direction.

37.english_meaning: A rising of the sea as a result of atmospheric pressure changes and wind associated with a storm.

37.example: The coastal villages were flooded due to a massive tidal surge.

37.english_meaning: Entered forcibly or without permission, or spilled over into an area.

37.english_meaning: Winds that change their direction in different seasons.
37.example: Monsoons in India are classic examples of seasonal winds.

37.english_meaning: Winds that blow only during a particular period of the day or year in a small area.
37.example: Land and sea breezes are forms of local winds.

37.english_meaning: Permanent easterly winds that blow towards the equator from the sub-tropical high-pressure belts.
37.example: The northeast and southeast trade winds converge near the equator.

37.english_meaning: Prevailing winds blowing from the west in the middle latitudes.
37.example: The prevailing westerlies blow from the sub-tropical high-pressure areas towards sub-polar low-pressure areas.

37.english_meaning: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth.
37.example: Changes in atmospheric pressure determine the weather conditions.

37.english_meaning: Likely to suffer from or experience something unpleasant.
37.hindi_meaning: प्रवृत्त / प्रवण / शिकार होने की संभावना वाला
37.example: Odisha is prone to cyclones originating in the Bay of Bengal.

37.english_meaning: Having a specified beginning or source.

38.english_meaning: A violent tropical storm with high winds that circulate around a center of low atmospheric pressure.
38.example: The supercyclone caused widespread devastation along the coast of Odisha.

38.english_meaning: In meteorology, an area of low atmospheric pressure that usually brings rain and bad weather.

38.english_meaning: Became or made much greater, stronger, or more severe.

38.english_meaning: Farm animals regarded as an asset, such as cattle, sheep, and pigs.

38.english_meaning: The process of increasing salt content in soil or water, often caused by tidal surges.
38.hindi_meaning: लवणीयकरण (मिट्टी में नमक की मात्रा बढ़ना)
38.example: Salinisation caused by the tidal surge turned large tracts of agricultural land infertile.

38.english_meaning: A tree or shrub that grows in chiefly tropical coastal swamps that are flooded by high tides.

38.english_meaning: Turns from a liquid into gas or vapor.

38.english_meaning: The state or quality of being humid; the amount of water vapor in the air.
38.example: Moisture in the air at any time is known as humidity.

38.english_meaning: Rain, snow, sleet, or hail that falls to the ground.
38.example: When water droplets become too heavy to float in the air, they come down as precipitation.

38.english_meaning: To maintain something in its original or existing state, or to protect from harm.
38.example: Plants and trees help preserve water by preventing rapid runoff.

38.english_meaning: A system of parts working together in a machine or a natural process.
38.example: On the basis of mechanism, there are three main types of rainfall.

38.english_meaning: Relating to the transfer of heat by the movement of gas or liquid.
38.example: Convectional rainfall occurs when warm air rises and cools.

38.example: Relief or orographic rainfall happens when moist air is forced to rise over mountains.

38.english_meaning: Relating to or characteristic of a cyclone or low-pressure weather system.
38.example: Cyclonic rainfall is caused by the interaction of warm and cold air masses.

39.english_meaning: The envelope of gases surrounding the earth or another planet.
39.hindi_meaning: वायुमंडल (पृथ्वी के चारों ओर गैसों का आवरण)
39.example: The atmosphere protects life on earth by absorbing ultraviolet solar radiation.

39.english_meaning: The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere due to the greater transparency of the atmosphere to visible radiation from the sun than to infrared radiation emitted from the planet's surface.
39.hindi_meaning: ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव (पृथ्वी की सतह का गर्म होना जब वायुमंडल की गैसें गर्मी को रोक लेती हैं)
39.example: Carbon dioxide creates a green house effect in the atmosphere by trapping heat.

39.english_meaning: The state of the atmosphere at a place and time as regards heat, dryness, sunshine, wind, rain, etc.
39.hindi_meaning: मौसम (किसी स्थान पर वायुमंडल की तात्कालिक स्थिति)
39.example: The weather today is sunny and pleasant.

39.english_meaning: The fall of rain; the amount of rain falling in a given area in a given time.
39.example: Rainfall is very important for the survival of plants and animals.

39.english_meaning: The pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of the earth.
39.hindi_meaning: वायुदाब (हवा के भार द्वारा डाला जाने वाला दबाव)
39.example: As we go up the layers of the atmosphere, the air pressure decreases.

39.english_meaning: A colorless unstable toxic gas with a pungent odor and powerful oxidizing properties, forming an enveloping layer in the stratosphere.
39.hindi_meaning: ओज़ोन गैस (एक गैस जो हमें सूर्य की हानिकारक किरणों से बचाती है)
39.example: The ozone layer protects us from harmful sun rays.

39.english_meaning: The lowest region of the atmosphere, extending from the earth's surface to a height of about 6–10 miles.
39.hindi_meaning: क्षोभमंडल (वायुमंडल की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण और निचली परत)
39.example: The troposphere is the most important layer of the atmosphere for weather phenomena.

39.english_meaning: The layer of the earth's atmosphere above the troposphere, extending to about 30 miles above the earth's surface.
39.hindi_meaning: समताप मंडल (वायुमंडल की वह परत जो बादलों से मुक्त होती है)
39.example: The stratosphere is ideal for flying aeroplanes because it is free from clouds.

39.english_meaning: The layer of the earth's atmosphere above the stratosphere and below the thermosphere.
39.hindi_meaning: मध्यमंडल (स्ट्रेटोस्फियर के ऊपर की वायुमंडलीय परत)
39.example: Meteorites burn up in the mesosphere upon entering the atmosphere.

39.english_meaning: The region of the atmosphere above the mesosphere and below the exosphere.
